from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from a single company's report for the reporting period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company, e.g. 'Shenzhen Zhenye (Group) Co., Ltd.'")
    total_operating_cost: float | None = Field(description="Total Operating Cost (营业总成本) for the period; numerator for the ratio check, denominator for the ratio calc")
    cash_paid_for_goods_and_services: float | None = Field(description="Cash Paid for Goods and Services (购买商品、接受劳务支付的现金) for the period; numerator for the ratio calc")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period string, e.g. '2025-Q1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted company financial metrics from the collection of documents."""
    financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
